> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **35** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ad434ba7ca2f3016f9f74ef78a19ae642667dcd3` — the merge of head `ec53068182c0b15fd57552fb774176ab8253919c` into base `fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ad434ba7ca2f3016f9f74ef78a19ae642667dcd3 && git checkout ad434ba7ca2f3016f9f74ef78a19ae642667dcd3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd ec53068182c0b15fd57552fb774176ab8253919c && git checkout -B drift-repro fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd && git merge --no-ff ec53068182c0b15fd57552fb774176ab8253919c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fe97d85b060b8314880e8ee5f6f897ffbb300bcd` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os db orphans` 现在也扫描「主表可选」的子对象(`controlled_by_parent` 对象唯一的 `master_detail` 声明为 `required: false`,#30905 裁决 A 放行的写法):这类行若指向一条已不存在的主记录,会被列为孤儿(`--delete` 时先导出再随级联删除);主表字段为空的行是合法的,不列出、不删除。
- 为什么改:扫描只认 `required: true` 的主表字段(spec 的 `isControlledByParentMasterField`),PR #30940 引入可选主表后,这类悬空行既没有任何用户入口能读到(访问权从不存在的主记录派生),`os db orphans` 也看不见。
- 风险与回滚:只改 CLI 的运维命令(手动执行、默认只报告不写);删除范围只多出「可选主表且主记录确已不存在」的行,判定复用 spec 已发布的 `controlledByParentMasterOf`,不改 spec。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/orphan-detail-sweep.ts` 的 `masterFieldsOf`(新判定,含 `sharingModel` 限定);`packages/cli/src/commands/db/orphans.integration.test.ts` 新夹具 `od_tip` 与改动的删除断言;`orphan-detail-sweep.test.ts` 新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/commands/db/orphans.integration.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全绿,其中 `[#30976]` 用例证明空主表行 `t_none` 不被列出、悬空行 `t_orphan` 被列为孤儿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

席位意见:接受。判定只多认「`controlled_by_parent` 对象的可选主表」这一种,复用 spec 已发布的 `controlledByParentMasterOf`,空主表行不列不删;越出认领的三个文件都是本改动让原文案或原测试失真而必须跟着改的。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:server#5` · Head-sha `ec53068182c0b15fd57552fb774176ab8253919c` · 2026-11-07T19:00Z

- **Shape:** 6 files, +219/−62, read from the diff. `orphan-detail-sweep.ts`: `objectsWithRequiredMaster` / `isRequiredMasterFinding` replaced by one predicate `masterFieldsOf` (required `master_detail` via `isControlledByParentMasterField`, plus, only when `sharingModel === 'controlled_by_parent'`, `controlledByParentMasterOf(fields)` answering `optional: true`). The removed export has no other reader in the tree. `orphans.ts` / `cli.mdx`: text only. No `packages/spec` edit.
- **Premise measured:** the dev re-read the predicate first; on main the sweep keyed on required masters only, so the card held (`premise_still_valid: true`).
- **Pins:** unit describe (optional-master dangling → orphan; null master → not listed; lone optional `master_detail` on a non-cbp object → `otherDangling`; required master as before) and the real-audit integration case (`t_orphan` listed, `t_none` not). Both negative pins ablated red and restored (report 6711430157).
- **Gates:** head check-runs 38 `success`, 12 skipped, none red or pending. `check-expected-skips`: OK, all 12 in main's roster (exit 0). `check-governed-merges`: no governed path, 281 changed lines ≤ 3000. The dev's `dispatch-gates --commands`: 92 derived, 92 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Mergeable state `clean`.
- **Accepted deviations:** file surface beyond the claim (`orphans.ts`, `cli.mdx`: shipped text this change made false; `orphans.integration.test.ts`: the only real-audit place the null-master half can go red, with the six module-top imports `check:test-source-alias` requires). Within the card's scope.
- **Out of scope:** none new. `Clause-②: no` (no accept set widened; the delete set grows only by rows that already break ADR-0055's access derivation), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs:` n/a. Changeset `@objectstack/cli` patch.
- **Landing:** Tier S path rules do not apply (ungoverned). `Fixes #30976`. Ready + auto-merge.
